subject: Quick EIN check + W-9/W-8BEN-E intake for PO setup (LunaCorp)
body:
From: Evan Morales <evan@lunacorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@lunacorp.com
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: W-9 + EIN letter for Redwood PO setup

Hi Jordan,

Attached are our completed W-9 and a copy of the EIN verification letter from the state. We're ready to be onboarded and would like to confirm any additional items you need to issue the PO (tax form on file, billing address confirmation, payment terms).

Attachments:
- LunaCorp_W9.pdf (PDF)
- LunaCorp_EIN_Letter.jpg (JPG)

Thanks,
Evan Morales
Head of Finance Operations
LunaCorp
E: evan@lunacorp.com
T: +1 415-555-0123

---

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Evan Morales <evan@lunacorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: W-9 + EIN letter for Redwood PO setup

Thanks Evan — received.

Monica and Kimberly, looping you both in to confirm the minimum evidence we need to clear PO-4521 to procurement and finance queues. Can you confirm: 1) W-9 received and name/EIN match; 2) billing address matches invoice; 3) whether we need a signed master services agreement before issuing the PO or if a PO against the quote is sufficient.

If helpful, I can push a draft PO into the procurement queue once we have the EIN match confirmed.

Jordan Blake
Sr. Procurement Partner
Redwood Inference

---

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Evan Morales <evan@lunacorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: W-9 + EIN letter for Redwood PO setup

Hi all — quick checklist from procurement ops after a review of the attachments Evan shared: 

- W-9: name on form = LunaCorp Inc. 
- EIN: matches the EIN on the state letter provided (last 4 digits cross-checked)
- Billing address: Evan, your address in the W-9 differs by a suite number from the quote. Please confirm which address to use on the PO (billing vs remit).
- Entity classification: domestic C-corp on W-9 — no W-8 needed.

Next steps we need before pushing PO: 
1) Evan confirms billing/remit address (reply inline).
2) Kimberly to confirm payment terms and whether we need an executed SOW/Master (finance side).
3) Once confirmed, procurement will create a PO draft and share the PO number for signature routing.

I do not require notarized documents for domestic vendors. Attaching the procurement intake checklist here for reference.

Attachments: procurement_onboard_checklist.pdf (internal)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Evan Morales <evan@lunacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: W-9 + EIN letter for Redwood PO setup

Evan — finance confirms we can proceed on PO issuance without an executed MSA for this initial one-off engagement. Standard net-30 payment terms will apply unless you request net-45 in writing and with business justification.

Jordan: please create PO-4521 with billing address as the suite included on the W-9 (see attached). I will route for approvals once the draft is in the system.

Evan: can you confirm whether purchase orders should be sent to billing@lunacorp.com and who to invoice (billing contact name)? If yes, procurement will issue the PO today.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
